featured_reviews.name: Nisha Das
featured_reviews.review_text:
Long Post Alert!

Women's Hospital "Room Harmony" has been etched in my memory as it  was my home for two and a half months.
I had a complicated pregnancy and was advised completed bed rest and was admitted under Dr. Gayatri Rao's guidance who turned my hope into reality. She is the sweetest soul who would brighten my dark days with her encouraging words and smile.
On April 2nd, I delivered a premature baby boy after the long tiring journey.
I would also like to thank the nurses who had made my stay homely with utmost care and positivity. They were nice to me and somehow became my friends by the time I was leaving.
A big shoutout to sisters - Vidya, Hema, Trishala, Smita, Mayuri, Namrata, Alpa, Yashika, Sunita and I might have missed few other names but I am equally grateful to each.

Not only the nurses even the maushis were accomodating everytime I had to use the loo as I was on complete bed rest.

Last but not the least, I would also love to mention few other doctors who helped me with the littlest difficulty, doubt, concern even during the middle of the night namely Dr. Dipali, Dr. Vijaya, Dr. Shalini, Dr. Surti and Dr. Dolly.

Dr. Dipali was very empathetic soul who would keep visiting my room and appreciating and encouraging me to overcome each day in the hospital. Dr. Vijaya would flawlessly put the IV drip's on me with most care and concern avoiding any chances of hurting me. Also, Dr. Manju sinha would keep visiting and advising me to read books for a positivity.

Another appreciation I would want to give the phlebotomist who would come for my blood tests and would tell me lovingly that I would be a good mom. I forgot her name but I hope you guys will find out who she is.

It was a tumultuous journey for both me and my husband, but the way Dr. Gayatri Rao made my pregnancy possible with her positive smile and golden words is beyond everything.

It was a long stay but it became bearable with each and every person mentioned above. Thank you guys, for helping me out during the most fragile yet memorable time of my life. I will always be indebted to this hospital.

The only drawback if I may mention are the charges of the hospital as it is located at the posh side of bandra khar. But, for middle class people like us the charges were indeed challenging.

featured_reviews.name: Lavina Dsouza
featured_reviews.review_text:
This was my first visit to Arya Hospital, and no doubt Dr. Vidya Patil was very polite and approachable however the overall experience could be significantly improved through better patient privacy, staff training, clear communication, and time management.

Firstly I got at appointment for 12:00 pm only to be attended at 1.40 pm which is a wait time approximately 1.5 hours for a consultation that lasted barely 15 minutes.
Personal and sensitive medical questions were asked in front of other patients, compromising ones privacy.
Staff appeared inadequately trained, as my blood pressure was initially recorded incorrectly. Later during consultation only after I pointed it out was the diagnosis reconsidered and the incorrect BP reading influenced the whole check up. Which was not appropriate.
Additional sonography tests were conducted on the spot, but the purpose, findings, and implications were not explained clearly. I had to repeatedly ask probing questions to understand symptoms, and recommended precautions. But the response was not precise or satisfactory. **Strategies to Improve Egg Quality and Number of Eggs**

Egg quality and egg number are crucial factors for successful conception, whether natural or through IVF. Egg number mainly depends on age and ovarian reserve, while egg quality reflects the genetic and metabolic health of the egg. Although new eggs cannot be created, the quality of existing eggs can be improved by optimizing the body’s internal environment.

A healthy lifestyle forms the foundation of good egg health. A balanced diet rich in proteins, antioxidants, fruits, vegetables, nuts, and healthy fats helps reduce oxidative stress on eggs. Maintaining an ideal body weight, avoiding smoking, alcohol, and excess caffeine, and ensuring adequate sleep are equally important. Stress reduction through yoga, meditation, or regular physical activity supports hormonal balance.

Medical optimization also plays a key role. Treating thyroid disorders, insulin resistance, and hormonal imbalances improves ovulation and ovarian response. Supplements such as CoQ10, myo-inositol, vitamin D, and omega-3 fatty acids may enhance egg quality when taken under medical supervision.

In IVF, individualized stimulation protocols, correct dosing, and precise timing can improve the number of mature eggs retrieved. Ultimately, improving egg quality and number is a gradual process, and early, personalized fertility care offers the best chance of success.
How to Improve Endometrial Thickness:

For pregnancy to occur, the uterus needs a healthy inner lining called the endometrium, where the embryo attaches and grows. In some women, this lining remains thin despite medicines, hormones, or fertility treatments. A thin endometrium can reduce the chances of embryo implantation, especially during IVF.

Mesenchymal Stem Cells (MSCs) are an advanced treatment option for women who do not respond to routine therapies. These special cells have the ability to repair and regenerate damaged tissues. They are usually obtained from safe sources such as the placenta or umbilical cord.

When MSCs are introduced into the uterus, they help improve blood flow, reduce scarring, and promote the growth of healthy endometrial tissue. Unlike treatments that work temporarily, MSC therapy aims to improve the overall quality of the uterine lining.

This therapy may benefit women with very thin endometrium, scarring after infections or surgery, or repeated IVF failures due to poor endometrial growth. MSC therapy is considered a specialized option and is recommended only after proper evaluation and counseling by a fertility specialist.
